messages:
Diego: quick alert — the internal runbook link from the release checklist is 404: /kb/runbooks/release-troubleshooting -> returns 404 in prod. spotted by customer diagnostic. anyone own that page? :sweat_smile:
Mira: I think that runbook was archived/moved during the last reorg. Did the shortlink get updated?
Kelsey (Docs): good catch. The page was moved under /kb/playbooks/release-troubleshooting-2025 and we meant to add a redirect. Looks like the redirect never landed.
Diego: can we do a hotfix? this link is in the onboarding checklist that infra uses during rollouts.
Kelsey (Docs): low-risk fix: add a shortlink entry + update the checklist reference. I'll open a tiny PR and include both actions so callers are fixed and legacy links still resolve.
scan-bot: nightly link-scan found 3 references to /kb/runbooks/release-troubleshooting (handbook, onboarding checklist, ops-runbook). Created ticket KB-4120 (prio: high).
Mira: heads-up — the ops-runbook is owned by @Diego, onboarding by @Mira, handbook by @Kelsey. I'll coordinate edits so we don't step on each other.
Diego: I'll hold off touching ops-runbook until Kelsey posts the PR. please tag me for a quick sanity check.
Kelsey (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7120 — includes shortlink mapping in data/shortlinks.yml and updates the onboarding checklist reference. cc @Mira @Diego
ops-bot: staging deploy queued for branch fix/runbook-redirect-8123456789 by Kelsey. CI checks: lint ✅, linkcheck pending.
Mira: quick review: please also add a one-line note in the runbook header saying "moved from /kb/runbooks/release-troubleshooting for 2025 reorg" so internal search results don't confuse people.
Kelsey (Docs): good call, added the note in the PR description and a small header comment in the doc.
Diego: sanity-tested staging: redirects to /kb/playbooks/release-troubleshooting-2025 and the onboarding checklist link now 200. canary looks clean for me. :thumbsup:
scan-bot: re-scan passed for changed pages. KB-4120 auto-closed.
Kelsey (Docs): will merge after one quick LGTM from docs. @Mira can you give a thumbs when you verify the onboarding email template that references the checklist?
Mira: verified the email template and onboarding flow, LGTM.
Kelsey (Docs): merged and deployed to prod. Filing follow-up ticket KB-4121 to add a nightly shortlink-sync job and an owner check for pages moved during reorgs. Thanks all for quick sync. :rocket:
